The train is scheduled to depart in mid-morning. After boarding, guests can settle into one of the dining cars and enjoy a late breakfast.

In the afternoon, the train stops for an excursion to the archaeological complex of Raqch'i, an important site of the Inca civilisation. Afterwards, the journey continues through the scenic landscapes of the La Raya mountain range. In the evening, cocktails and canapés are served in the Piano Bar, followed by dinner. Guests spend the night aboard the train, which stops near the shores of Lake Titicaca.

An early start offers the chance to see a spectacular sunrise over the calm waters of Lake Titicaca. This is followed by a celebratory farewell breakfast aboard the Belmond Andean Explorer before disembarking in Puno.

Your introduction to Bogotá begins in the streets of La Candelaria. The Gold Museum displays around 34,000 gold artefacts and more than 25,000 other objects from the pre-Columbian era. Next, you will see the Casa de la Moneda Mint and works by Fernando Botero, including paintings, drawings and sculptures.

The route passes through Bolívar Square, with its cathedral, Casa de Nariño, Liévano Palace and Palace of Justice. The excursion ends with an ascent to Monserrate and views over Bogotá.

This particular private itinerary lasts 6 hours. It includes private transport, an English-speaking guide, tickets to the listed museums, the ascent to Monserrate and a local medical insurance card.

## The Clear Waters of Bom Jardim

Bom Jardim lies in a region where the Cerrado meets the Amazon rainforest. It is known for its clear rivers, caves and natural pools.

After arriving, visitors follow a short trail to the Enchanted Aquarium and the Salobra River. They spend about two hours in the water, moving with the natural current, swimming among fish and observing the underwater world through the clear water.

The aquatic excursion offers an up-close view of plants and fish, with wooded riverbanks nearby throughout the journey.
